verdict.rationale: Smithery is a hosted MCP connection and registry service, so letting users choose a data region is a fair axis. The evidence pack never mentions region selection or data residency controls. Encrypted credential storage and Uplink, which exposes servers running on your own machine, are adjacent features and do not let users choose where Smithery stores their data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
